protocol.confidence: max probability over non-IDK candidates for aa_omniscience, max candidate probability for all other native tasks; matches original figure generation
protocol.thresholdRule: abstain if score < gamma; preserve native abstention
protocol.adapterPolicy: Retained best adapter is used only with explicit epistemic abstention option; other native task schemas bypass it. No candidate added or task action relabeled.
protocol.accuracy: correct_mass / n over ALL scorable decisions
protocol.undefinedNhr: null when abstained + wrong_mass is zero
protocol.crossTaskNhr: For non-factual classification/tool-selection tasks, NHR is the explicitly defined selective-decision abstention-versus-error ratio, not an official generative hallucination metric. Harmful/benign, no-tool, call/ask and other native labels remain task actions, not epistemic abstentions.
protocol.inference: One native categorical distribution per case; all32 thresholds evaluated exactly offline. Threshold does not change model inference.

omniscienceData.training: Independently synthesized by the GS1 team.
